title: hyacinthus orientalis var. albulus
intro: Hyacinthus orientalis var. albulus, commonly known as white hyacinth or white garden hyacinth, is a type of flowering bulbous perennial plant that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. The white hyacinth has been used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of white hyacinth include its sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which make it useful for treating conditions such as insomnia and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of white hyacinth include alkaloids like scopolamine, hyoscyamine, and hyoscine, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
